description.ja: 「新ULTRAMAN SUIT PROJECT」第１弾！『ULTRAMAN』よりオリジナル武器を付属してULTRAMAN SUIT TIGAが登場！
description.en: "New ULTRAMAN SUIT PROJECT " first installment! ULTRAMAN SUIT TIGA is now available with original weapons from " ULTRAMAN"!

description.ja: • 清水栄一先生完全描きおろし。
• 赤・紫の装甲をグロスインジェクション、銀色はエクストラフィニッシュでボディ表面の質感を再現。
description.en: • The red and purple armor is gloss-injected, and the silver is an extra finish to reproduce the texture of the body surface.

description.ja: • オリジナル武器のゼペリオンスピアはクリアパーツで成形。
description.en: • The original weapon Zeperion Spear is molded with clear parts.

description.ja: • 広範囲な可動域で必殺技ゼペリオン光線の構えポーズを再現可能。
description.en: • A wide range of motion allows you to recreate the stance pose of the special move Zeperion Ray.

description.ja: • 必殺ポーズを彩るエフェクトパーツも付属。
description.en: • Effect parts to color the special pose are also included.

description.ja: • 胸部に収めることができるLEDユニットが付属。胸と目を光らせることができる。
description.en: • Comes with an LED unit that can be stored in the chest. You can make your chest and eyes shine.

accessories.en: LED unit x 1 (LR41 x 2 sold separately)
